description: Numbered, line-aligned original-language and English creed text (lex issue #12). n runs continuously through each document; orig and eng are split at the same clause. Joined with single spaces, eng equals the English section text in creeds.db.

God the Father.eng: I believe in God, the Father almighty,

Jesus Christ.orig: Et in Iesum Christum, Filium eius unicum, Dominum nostrum,
Jesus Christ.eng: I believe in Jesus Christ, his only Son, our Lord,

Jesus Christ.orig: qui conceptus est de Spiritu Sancto,
Jesus Christ.eng: who was conceived by the Holy Spirit,
was crucified, died, and was buried;
On the third day he rose again;

Jesus Christ.orig: sedet ad dexteram Dei Patris omnipotentis;
Jesus Christ.eng: he is seated at the right hand of the Father,

Jesus Christ.orig: inde venturus est iudicare vivos et mortuos.
Jesus Christ.eng: and he will come to judge the living and the dead.

The Holy Spirit and the Church.eng: I believe in the Holy Spirit,

God the Father.orig: Πιστεύομεν εἰς ἕνα Θεόν, Πατέρα, παντοκράτορα,
God the Father.eng: We believe in one God, the Father almighty,
of all things visible and invisible.

Jesus Christ the Son.orig: Καὶ εἰς ἕνα Κύριον Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν,
Jesus Christ the Son.eng: And in one Lord Jesus Christ,

Jesus Christ the Son.orig: τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ τὸν μονογενῆ,
τὸν ἐκ τοῦ Πατρὸς γεννηθέντα πρὸ πάντων τῶν αἰώνων·
Jesus Christ the Son.eng: begotten from the Father before all ages,

Jesus Christ the Son.orig: φῶς ἐκ φωτός, Θεὸν ἀληθινὸν ἐκ Θεοῦ ἀληθινοῦ,
Jesus Christ the Son.eng: God from God, Light from Light, true God from true God,
of the same essence as the Father.
Through him all things were made.

Jesus Christ the Son.orig: Τὸν δι᾿ ἡμᾶς τοὺς ἀνθρώπους καὶ διὰ τὴν ἡμετέραν σωτηρίαν κατελθόντα ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν
Jesus Christ the Son.eng: For us and for our salvation he came down from heaven;

Jesus Christ the Son.orig: καὶ σαρκωθέντα ἐκ Πνεύματος ἁγίου καὶ Μαρίας τῆς Παρθένου
Jesus Christ the Son.eng: he became incarnate by the Holy Spirit and the virgin Mary,

Jesus Christ the Son.orig: Σταυρωθέντα τε ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν ἐπὶ Ποντίου Πιλάτου
Jesus Christ the Son.eng: He was crucified for us under Pontius Pilate;

Jesus Christ the Son.orig: Καὶ ἀναστάντα τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ, κατὰ τὰς Γραφάς.
Jesus Christ the Son.eng: The third day he rose again, according to the Scriptures.

Jesus Christ the Son.orig: καὶ καθεζόμενον ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ Πατρός.
Jesus Christ the Son.eng: and is seated at the right hand of the Father.

Jesus Christ the Son.orig: Καὶ πάλιν ἐρχόμενον μετὰ δόξης κρῖναι ζῶντας καὶ νεκρούς,
Jesus Christ the Son.eng: He will come again with glory to judge the living and the dead.

Jesus Christ the Son.orig: οὗ τῆς βασιλείας οὐκ ἔσται τέλος.

The Holy Spirit.orig: Καὶ εἰς τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον, τὸ κύριον, τὸ ζωοποιόν,
The Holy Spirit.eng: And we believe in the Holy Spirit, the Lord, the giver of life.
He proceeds from the Father and the Son,

The Holy Spirit.orig: τὸ σὺν Πατρὶ καὶ Υἱῷ συμπροσκυνούμενον καὶ συνδοξαζόμενον,
The Holy Spirit.eng: and with the Father and the Son is worshiped and glorified.

The Church and Final Hope.orig: Εἰς μίαν, ἁγίαν, καθολικὴν καὶ ἀποστολικὴν Ἐκκλησίαν.
The Church and Final Hope.eng: We believe in one holy catholic and apostolic church.

The Church and Final Hope.orig: Ὁμολογοῦμεν ἓν βάπτισμα εἰς ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν.
The Church and Final Hope.eng: We affirm one baptism for the forgiveness of sins.
We look forward to the resurrection of the dead,

The Church and Final Hope.orig: καὶ ζωὴν τοῦ μέλλοντος αἰῶνος. Ἀμήν.
The Church and Final Hope.eng: and to life in the world to come. Amen.

Opening.orig: Quicunque vult salvus esse, ante omnia opus est, ut teneat catholicam fidem:
Opening.eng: Whosoever will be saved, before all things it is necessary that he hold the Catholic Faith.

Opening.orig: Quam nisi quisque integram inviolatamque servaverit, absque dubio in aeternum peribit.
Opening.eng: Which Faith except everyone do keep whole and undefiled, without doubt he shall perish everlastingly.

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Fides autem catholica haec est: ut unum Deum in Trinitate, et Trinitatem in unitate veneremur.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: And the Catholic Faith is this: That we worship one God in Trinity, and Trinity in Unity;

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Neque confundentes personas, neque substantiam separantes.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: Neither confounding the Persons, nor dividing the Substance.

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Alia est enim persona Patris alia Filii, alia Spiritus Sancti:
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: For there is one Person of the Father, another of the Son, and another of the Holy Ghost.

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Sed Patris, et Filii, et Spiritus Sancti una est divinitas, aequalis gloria, coaeterna maiestas.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: But the Godhead of the Father, of the Son and of the Holy Ghost is all One, the Glory Equal, the Majesty Co-Eternal.

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Qualis Pater, talis Filius, talis Spiritus Sanctus.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: Such as the Father is, such is the Son, and such is the Holy Ghost.

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Increatus Pater, increatus Filius, increatus Spiritus Sanctus.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: The Father Uncreate, the Son Uncreate, and the Holy Ghost Uncreate.

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Immensus Pater, immensus Filius, immensus Spiritus Sanctus.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: The Father Incomprehensible, the Son Incomprehensible, and the Holy Ghost Incomprehensible.

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Aeternus Pater, aeternus Filius, aeternus Spiritus Sanctus.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: The Father Eternal, the Son Eternal, and the Holy Ghost Eternal

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Et tamen non tres aeterni, sed unus aeternus.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: and yet they are not Three Eternals but One Eternal.

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Sicut non tres increati, nec tres immensi, sed unus increatus, et unus immensus.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: As also there are not Three Uncreated, nor Three Incomprehensibles, but One Uncreated, and One Incomprehensible.

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Similiter omnipotens Pater, omnipotens Filius, omnipotens Spiritus Sanctus.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: So likewise the Father is Almighty, the Son Almighty, and the Holy Ghost Almighty.

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Et tamen non tres omnipotentes, sed unus omnipotens.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: And yet they are not Three Almighties but One Almighty.

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Ita Deus Pater, Deus Filius, Deus Spiritus Sanctus.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: So the Father is God, the Son is God, and the Holy Ghost is God.

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Et tamen non tres Dii, sed unus est Deus.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: And yet they are not Three Gods, but One God.

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Ita Dominus Pater, Dominus Filius, Dominus Spiritus Sanctus.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: So likewise the Father is Lord, the Son Lord, and the Holy Ghost Lord.

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Et tamen non tres Domini, sed unus est Dominus.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: And yet not Three Lords but One Lord.

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Quia, sicut singillatim unamquamque personam Deum ac Dominum confiteri christiana veritate compellimur:
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: For, like as we are compelled by the Christian verity to acknowledge every Person by Himself to be God and Lord,

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: ita tres Deos aut Dominos dicere catholica religione prohibemur.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: so are we forbidden by the Catholic Religion to say, there be Three Gods or Three Lords.

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Pater a nullo est factus: nec creatus, nec genitus.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: The Father is made of none, neither created, nor begotten.

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Filius a Patre solo est: non factus, nec creatus, sed genitus.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: The Son is of the Father alone; not made, nor created, but begotten.

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Spiritus Sanctus a Patre et Filio: non factus, nec creatus, nec genitus, sed procedens.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: The Holy Ghost is of the Father, and of the Son neither made, nor created, nor begotten, but proceeding.

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Unus ergo Pater, non tres Patres: unus Filius, non tres Filii: unus Spiritus Sanctus, non tres Spiritus Sancti.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: So there is One Father, not Three Fathers; one Son, not Three Sons; One Holy Ghost, not Three Holy Ghosts.

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Et in hac Trinitate nihil prius aut posterius, nihil maius aut minus:
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: And in this Trinity none is afore or after another; None is greater or less than another,

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: sed totae tres personae coaeternae sibi sunt et coaequales.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: but the whole Three Persons are Co-eternal together, and Co-equal.

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Ita ut per omnia, sicut iam supra dictum est, et unitas in Trinitate, et Trinitas in unitate veneranda sit.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: So that in all things, as is aforesaid, the Unity in Trinity, and the Trinity in Unity, is to be worshipped.

The Doctrine of the Trinity.orig: Qui vult ergo salvus esse, ita de Trinitate sentiat.
The Doctrine of the Trinity.eng: He therefore that will be saved, must thus think of the Trinity.

The Incarnation of Christ.orig: Sed necessarium est ad aeternam salutem, ut incarnationem quoque Domini nostri Iesu Christi fideliter credat.
The Incarnation of Christ.eng: Furthermore, it is necessary to everlasting salvation that he also believe rightly the Incarnation of our Lord Jesus Christ.

The Incarnation of Christ.orig: Est ergo fides recta ut credamus et confiteamur, quia Dominus noster Iesus Christus, Dei Filius, Deus et homo est.
The Incarnation of Christ.eng: For the right Faith is, that we believe and confess that our Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of God, is God and Man.

The Incarnation of Christ.orig: Deus est ex substantia Patris ante saecula genitus:
The Incarnation of Christ.eng: God, of the Substance of the Father, begotten before the worlds;

The Incarnation of Christ.orig: et homo est ex substantia matris in saeculo natus.
The Incarnation of Christ.eng: and Man, of the Substance of His Mother, born in the world.

The Incarnation of Christ.orig: Perfectus Deus, perfectus homo: ex anima rationabili et humana carne subsistens.
The Incarnation of Christ.eng: Perfect God, and perfect Man, of a reasonable soul and human flesh subsisting.

The Incarnation of Christ.orig: Aequalis Patri secundum divinitatem: minor Patre secundum humanitatem.
The Incarnation of Christ.eng: Equal to the Father, as touching His Godhead, and inferior to the Father, as touching His Manhood.

The Incarnation of Christ.orig: Qui licet Deus sit et homo, non duo tamen, sed unus est Christus.
The Incarnation of Christ.eng: Who, although He be God and Man, yet He is not two, but one Christ.

The Incarnation of Christ.orig: Unus autem non conversione divinitatis in carnem, sed assumptione humanitatis in Deum.
The Incarnation of Christ.eng: One, not by conversion of the Godhead into flesh, but by taking of the Manhood into God.

The Incarnation of Christ.orig: Unus omnino, non confusione substantiae, sed unitate personae.
The Incarnation of Christ.eng: One altogether, not by confusion of Substance, but by unity of Person.

The Incarnation of Christ.orig: Nam sicut anima rationabilis et caro unus est homo: ita Deus et homo unus est Christus.
The Incarnation of Christ.eng: For as the reasonable soul and flesh is one man, so God and Man is one Christ;

The Incarnation of Christ.orig: Qui passus est pro salute nostra: descendit ad inferos: tertia die resurrexit a mortuis.
The Incarnation of Christ.eng: Who suffered for our salvation, descended into hell, rose again the third day from the dead.

The Incarnation of Christ.orig: Ascendit ad caelos, sedet ad dexteram Dei Patris omnipotentis:
The Incarnation of Christ.eng: He ascended into heaven, He sitteth on the right hand of the Father, God Almighty,

The Incarnation of Christ.orig: inde venturus est iudicare vivos et mortuos.
The Incarnation of Christ.eng: from whence He shall come to judge the quick and the dead.

The Incarnation of Christ.orig: Ad cuius adventum omnes homines resurgere habent cum corporibus suis:
The Incarnation of Christ.eng: At whose coming all men shall rise again with their bodies

The Incarnation of Christ.orig: et reddituri sunt de factis propriis rationem.
The Incarnation of Christ.eng: and shall give account for their own works.

The Incarnation of Christ.orig: Et qui bona egerunt, ibunt in vitam aeternam:
The Incarnation of Christ.eng: And they that have done good shall go into life everlasting,

The Incarnation of Christ.orig: qui vero mala, in ignem aeternum.
The Incarnation of Christ.eng: and they that have done evil into everlasting fire.

Conclusion.orig: Haec est fides catholica, quam nisi quisque fideliter firmiterque crediderit, salvus esse non poterit.
Conclusion.eng: This is the Catholic Faith, which except a man believe faithfully, he cannot be saved.

Introduction.orig: Ἡ ἁγία καὶ μεγάλη καὶ οἰκουμενικὴ σύνοδος, ἡ κατὰ θεοῦ χάριν καὶ θέσπισμα τῶν εὐσεβεστάτων καὶ φιλοχρίστων ἡμῶν βασιλέων Μαρκιανοῦ καὶ Οὐαλεντινιανοῦ Αὐγούστων ἐν Χαλκηδόνι τῇ μητροπόλει τῆς Βιθυνῶν ἐπαρχίας συναχθεῖσα ἐν τῷ μαρτυρίῳ τῆς ἁγίας καὶ καλλινίκου μάρτυρος Εὐφημίας, ὥρισε τὰ ὑποτεταγμένα.
Introduction.eng: The holy, great, and ecumenical synod, assembled by the grace of God and the command of our most religious and Christian Emperors, Marcian and Valentinian, Augusti, at Chalcedon, the metropolis of the Bithynian Province, in the martyry of the holy and victorious martyr Euphemia, has decreed as follows:

Introduction.orig: Ὁ κύριος ἡμῶν καὶ σωτὴρ Ἰησοῦς Χριστός, τὴν τῆς πίστεως γνῶσιν τοῖς μαθηταῖς βεβαιῶν, ἔφη πρὸς αὐτούς· Εἰρήνην τὴν ἐμὴν δίδωμι ὑμῖν, εἰρήνην τὴν ἐμὴν ἀφίημι ὑμῖν, πρὸς τὸ μηδένα πρὸς τὸν πλησίον διχονοεῖν ἐν τοῖς τῆς εὐσεβείας δόγμασιν, ἀλλ' ἐπίσης τοῖς πᾶσι τὸ τῆς ἀληθείας ἐπιδείκνυσθαι κήρυγμα.
Introduction.eng: Our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, when strengthening the knowledge of the Faith in his disciples, to the end that no one might disagree with his neighbour concerning the doctrines of religion, and that the proclamation of the truth might be set forth equally to all men, said, 'My peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you.'

The Definition.orig: Ἑπόμενοι τοίνυν τοῖς ἁγίοις πατράσιν, ἕνα καὶ τὸν αὐτὸν ὁμολογεῖν υἱὸν τὸν κύριον ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν συμφώνως ἅπαντες ἐκδιδάσκομεν,
The Definition.eng: Following the holy Fathers we teach with one voice that the Son of God and our Lord Jesus Christ is to be confessed as one and the same Person,

The Definition.orig: τέλειον τὸν αὐτὸν ἐν θεότητι καὶ τέλειον τὸν αὐτὸν ἐν ἀνθρωπότητι, θεὸν ἀληθῶς καὶ ἄνθρωπον ἀληθῶς τὸν αὐτόν, ἐκ ψυχῆς λογικῆς καὶ σώματος,
The Definition.eng: that he is perfect in Godhead and perfect in manhood, very God and very man, of a reasonable soul and human body;

The Definition.orig: ὁμοούσιον τῷ πατρὶ κατὰ τὴν θεότητα καὶ ὁμοούσιον τὸν αὐτὸν ἡμῖν κατὰ τὴν ἀνθρωπότητα,
The Definition.eng: consubstantial with the Father as touching his Godhead, and consubstantial with us as touching his manhood;

The Definition.orig: κατὰ πάντα ὅμοιον ἡμῖν χωρὶς ἁμαρτίας·
The Definition.eng: made in all things like us, sin only excepted;

The Definition.orig: πρὸ αἰώνων μὲν ἐκ τοῦ πατρὸς γεννηθέντα κατὰ τὴν θεότητα,
The Definition.eng: begotten of his Father before the worlds according to his Godhead;

The Definition.orig: ἐπ' ἐσχάτων δὲ τῶν ἡμερῶν τὸν αὐτὸν δι' ἡμᾶς καὶ διὰ τὴν ἡμετέραν σωτηρίαν ἐκ Μαρίας τῆς παρθένου τῆς θεοτόκου κατὰ τὴν ἀνθρωπότητα,
The Definition.eng: in these last days born of the Virgin Mary, the Mother of God, according to his manhood.

The Definition.orig: ἕνα καὶ τὸν αὐτὸν Χριστόν, υἱόν, κύριον, μονογενῆ, ἐν δύο φύσεσιν ἀσυγχύτως, ἀτρέπτως, ἀδιαιρέτως, ἀχωρίστως γνωριζόμενον·
The Definition.eng: This one and the same Jesus Christ, the only-begotten Son of God, must be confessed to be in two natures, unconfusedly, immutably, indivisibly, inseparably united,

The Definition.orig: οὐδαμοῦ τῆς τῶν φύσεων διαφορᾶς ἀνῃρημένης διὰ τὴν ἕνωσιν,
The Definition.eng: and that without the distinction of natures being taken away by such union,

The Definition.orig: σωζομένης δὲ μᾶλλον τῆς ἰδιότητος ἑκατέρας φύσεως καὶ εἰς ἓν πρόσωπον καὶ μίαν ὑπόστασιν συντρεχούσης,
The Definition.eng: but rather the peculiar property of each nature being preserved and being united in one Person and subsistence,

The Definition.orig: οὐκ εἰς δύο πρόσωπα μεριζόμενον ἢ διαιρούμενον, ἀλλ' ἕνα καὶ τὸν αὐτὸν υἱὸν καὶ μονογενῆ θεὸν λόγον, κύριον Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν·
The Definition.eng: not separated or divided into two persons, but one and the same Son and only-begotten, God the Word, our Lord Jesus Christ;

The Definition.orig: καθάπερ ἄνωθεν οἱ προφῆται περὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτὸς ἡμᾶς ὁ κύριος Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς ἐξεπαίδευσε καὶ τὸ τῶν πατέρων ἡμῖν παραδέδωκε σύμβολον.
The Definition.eng: even as the Prophets from the beginning spoke concerning him, and as the Lord Jesus Christ instructed us, and as the Creed of the Fathers has delivered to us.

Prohibitions.orig: Τούτων τοίνυν μετὰ πάσης πανταχόθεν ἀκριβείας τε καὶ ἐμμελείας διατυπωθέντων ἡμῖν, ὥρισεν ἡ ἁγία καὶ οἰκουμενικὴ σύνοδος, ἑτέραν πίστιν μηδενὶ ἐξεῖναι προφέρειν, ἤγουν συγγράφειν ἢ συντιθέναι ἢ φρονεῖν ἢ διδάσκειν ἑτέρους·
Prohibitions.eng: These things, therefore, having been expressed by us with the greatest accuracy and attention, the holy Ecumenical Synod defines that no one shall be permitted to bring forward a different faith, nor to write, nor to put together, nor to excogitate, nor to teach it to others.

Prohibitions.orig: τοὺς δὲ τολμῶντας ἢ συντιθέναι πίστιν ἑτέραν, ἤγουν προκομίζειν ἢ διδάσκειν ἢ παραδιδόναι ἕτερον σύμβολον τοῖς ἐθέλουσιν ἐπιστρέφειν εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν τῆς ἀληθείας ἐξ Ἑλληνισμοῦ ἢ ἐξ Ἰουδαϊσμοῦ ἢ γοῦν ἐξ αἱρέσεως οἱασδηποτοῦν,
Prohibitions.eng: But such as dare either to put together another faith, or to bring forward or to teach or to deliver a different Creed to such as wish to be converted to the knowledge of the truth from the Gentiles, or Jews or any heresy whatever,

Prohibitions.orig: τούτους, εἰ μὲν εἶεν ἐπίσκοποι ἢ κληρικοί, ἀλλοτρίους εἶναι τοὺς ἐπισκόπους τῆς ἐπισκοπῆς καὶ τοὺς κληρικοὺς τοῦ κλήρου,
Prohibitions.eng: if they be Bishops or clerics let them be deposed, the Bishops from the Episcopate, and the clerics from the clergy;

Prohibitions.orig: εἰ δὲ μονάζοντες ἢ λαϊκοὶ εἶεν, ἀναθεματίζεσθαι.
Prohibitions.eng: but if they be monks or laics, let them be anathematized.
